verdicts.reason: A: the spec grid is broken up and scattered. 250 g and BT 5.4 are unreadably tiny, and BT 5.4 sits on the cropped circle. The tagline and legal text are squeezed into narrow ragged columns beside the CTA, and the headphone circle is cut off at the right edge. B: the specs are also scattered at random sizes (BT 5.4, 40 h and 250 g are tiny), and the tagline and legal text are thin, word-per-line columns. Still, the headphones stay whole, and the headline and CTA form a clear group with the CTA prominent, so B is slightly less broken.
